title: Balance in Nature: Predators and Prey
summary: How tigers, deer and grass keep each other in check, and what happens when that balance is broken.

ib.note: Population dynamics models appear in DP

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 12: How Nature Works in Harmony

objectives: I can describe how predator and prey populations affect each other.
I can interpret population graphs over time.
I can explain the role of top predators and evaluate human impacts on balance.
misconceptions: Killing predators always helps prey animals.
More deer is always better for a forest.
